title: Blue Berry Pie
description: A light weight vanilla friendly modpack with dungeons and a better terrain generation. with a little extra.
body: A lightweight vanilla friendly modpack that I put together and have been playing for a few while and wanted to share. with a little extra like, Optimization mods for better performance Dungeons and taverns and few other for better exploration experience, cliff tree and no mans land for better terrian generation, and new ores from Bronze and Galosphere. A very lovely modpack.
